content: Yeso aa begeshe be ogomo Bilatus
Nangka ara asane, na pate andaamoole magame Ashili kaa andaano aromo gwaara angmǝ azaa nangka neya wongha Yeso.
Nane tere kai, aane ale ka kai aa begeshe be Ogomo Bilatus.
Ogbwǝ o Yahuda
Awere aka Yahuda ooka wa nayi kai wa laka aa core Yeso angmǝ wongha, na wa kone oburǝ, nawa kuri ara andaamoole magame ma Ashili kaa andaano, nawa kuriyǝ ne ma azorpa tuuru taaro name.
Awa bekaana, “Ma ya madinǝ ka ma nya ondooka wata tambo ne ka wongha kai.” Nane bekaana, “Eya manyi maro? Onna a owa wai.”
Na Yahuda me bacakare o azorpa me a akwilǝ Ashili, na wa suri, na wa ale aa wa ye lesara.
Azaa nyimi na andaamoole magame Ashili ne shende emate me aa ne bekaana, “Wata gwara aa eke emate eena e a lebengga le akwilǝ Ashili ne, obena emate me e manyau e.”
Azaa nyimi na ne nya tukpwei madoola na, ne embe adeze a ondo sowa madaka ka emate me ka a itǝ adeze o taasa a ageng.
Nyimia wa ote, a deya o ngmeengme a rareze arame na ugiishi manyau.
Azaa nyimia a panza angmǝ a Ondo o beya angmǝ ka mawo ma Ashili Irimiya ka wa beke na, “Ne jeke emate tuuru taaro, emate eeka aromo a Isrela ne kabare na are azaa kai naname,
nane embe adeze ondo o sooza madaka ka e, nangka Ateokora ka oteng.”
Bilatus wa eze Yeso be pirǝ
Na Yeso itǝ a begeshe be ondo togomo, na ondo togomo teme kang pirkǝ kai na, “Boo na, boa Ogomo maYahuda na?” Yeso ka kabare na, “Nangka baa beka.”
Nangka ne andaamoole magame ma Ashili kaa andaano ne beye kai majǝkǝri, naka ta beke eyapa ne.
Na Bilatus bekaa akai na, “Ota ba kona e pate epa eena ane beyau majǝkǝri azame ne?”
Na Yeso ta ka kabare na be pirǝ be yende ne, na nyimi tere ogomo ukpwei aa bote.
A core Yeso o gǝǝzǝ o gbwǝ
Koonang awere Ozǝnggǝ Ocakate, ondo togomo wa mena aa peere oromo yende aa nyimia andaaka a pate a akwilǝ andaleme, ooka aromo ne zaka.
Awere name, ondo zene a akwilǝ andaleme ka a rose wai ka ogirǝ, ka a beya wai na Barabas.
Nangka maYahuda ne kurkǝnǝng, na Bilatus pirkǝ nee na, “Mana eya yeme ang pere ying wai? Barabas naa, na Yeso kamea arareze kai na Almasipu?”
Obena wa rose na le'ero le ote nane turki Yeso awai.

Bangka nyimi kangza, awere aka wa ya cikǝ a ledǝndǝ le cora angmǝ, ondaye wai wa tong na abele wai na, “Karomo kana ta kaa ya eyapa ne. Sǝǝrǝ taara to orooka karomo kaana obena ma zitǝ a tolau kaya kai.”
Andaamoole magame ma Ashili kaa andaano ne tarze aromo aa ne baale ne na ne zaka Barabas ka ne cǝ kane wong Yeso.
Na ogomo me kang pirkǝ aromo me na, “A nyimi aromo leere aana, mana eya yeme ang pere ying wai?” Na ne bekaana, “Barabas.”
Na Bilatus bekaa na, “Na ang wiinia ka Yeso ka rareze kai na Almasipu?” Na pate one kabare na “A gendare kai a uti!”
Na Bilatus pirkǝ ne, “Azaa eya? Ombela araaburu ka eza?” Na ne waale o ara angmelo na, “A gendare kai a uti.”

Nangka Bilatus wa laka wa era wata ya eyapa ne, kangza a nyong aromo ya waale o caro, na wa mangka manyi na wa kwizǝ taara tewai aa aromo ya gonta, aa wa bekaana, “Mi, ma kwizǝ a taara teng aa manyau ma karomo ka o dera madinǝ kaana. Onna zitǝ oying wai.”
Na pate aromo me kabare na, “Baya ozitǝ ome itǝ azaa aro kaa ayana aro.”
Awere namea wa pere ne Barabas. Malo oka wa ote na ole Yeso, aa wa nayi kai ka gendare.
Ana o tesa a geza a moole ne zeele Yeso
Na ana otesa ageza aa moole o ogomo ale ka Yeso a akwilǝ togomo, nane kurki pate legwa le ana otesa ageza a moole o makeke mame azaa kai.
Na ne lope madibi maaka maya lepung le kai, aa ne amba kai odibi o ganggo o togomo.

Na ne pi betageya be ekana, aa ne amba kai ukpwei, aa ne nya kai lebenda le yende o ara ore o kai, na ne kang tungunu a begeshe be kai aa ne zeele kai, aa ne beyaana kai na, “Ashili waloo ne, Ogomo maYahuda!”
Aa ne karze kai mawo, nane jeke lebenda lenname nane ola kai kaa le o ukpwei.
Nangka ne mare o zeela kai, nane lope kai odibi o togomo te me, aa kuriyǝ kai madibi maaka maya kai a lepung, nane ale ka kai ka ne gendare uti.
A gendare Yeso
Ne ya teweno naname, nane gwarnang ka Saminu, oromo a Siyarin. Waya ne ote nawa ana uti o gendare a Yeso.
Nangka ne dukǝ ara aka arareze ai na Golgota, araaka a rose ai na ara o cako ukpwei,
nane nya kai manyi ma inabi maaka a sakale ka ka o ngmangmang ka ka se. Nangka ka lembe ka leleng, naka nyana o sa me.
Malo o gendare a Yeso, nane eze o zawa azaa madibi ma kai kane laka mana yo jeka odibi me.
Malo nyimi nane cikǝ arame aa le'enda le kai.
A aza uti me, aza kaa ukpwei o kai, nane wele aa kati ka patarake ka yende na, “KANNAA YESO, OGOMO MAYAHUDA.”
Nane kang gendare kai legwa kaa akǝri o tǝǝru aromo a leere, oyende o ara ore, aa o yende o ara uguri kai.
Ana o kaale ne ne zeele kai, aa ne zuu ukpwei,
aa ne beyaana, “Bo ka baa bekaana, ba era o oka akwilǝ Ashili, oo kang sowa ai a nyimi amora taaro, na boza o ukpwei o! Na bo Kena ka Ashili baaza, jipi a uti ogendare me!”
Nyimia kangza andaamoole magame ma Ashili ka ana o baala angmǝ aaka Ashili a nya Mosa ka andaano aromo ne zeele kai, aa ne beyaana,
“Ka boza ana ondo, aa ka girǝ o boza ukpwei kai. Kai ya Ogomo Isrela sang? Kaa jipi a uti ogendare na nannameena, awere namea te yo kabare ka kai.
Ka eke lenyong a Ashili, baya a Ashili me boza kai nanname, aaya yeme a kai, obena ka bekaana kai Kena ka Ashilia kai.”
Pate a akǝri o tǝǝru a aromo ka a gendare ne ka Yeso ne beya akai angmǝ a aburu.
Ogbwǝ o Yeso
Na maring meke pate makeke mame aa era o tera ongme aa dukǝ beru be o taaro ulyǝlu.
Nangka ongme wa amara ka otaru, na Yeso ara lengmelo ajǝng, na ka bekaana, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabatani?” Obena, “Ashili ang, Ashili ang, eyaaka ba nyang o malo?”
Aromo aa ka neya itǝ a ting arame ne kone nyimi na ne bekaana, “Karomo kaana kaya orara Ileya!”
Na ondo a nyimi one song nawa jeke lesuni nawa tǝkǝzǝ a manyi ma marara, nawa ote a lebenda, aa wa nayi Yeso na ka se.
Azaa nyimi odangare me bekaana, “Bayana te laka na Ileya yo deya kawa boza kai.”
Na Yeso kang ara lengmelo a jǝng, aa ka pere ebeene e kai.
Nyimia oyambati ka waya a akwilǝ Ashili wa daro a tera madǝkǝni ma leere, o era obora aaza a jǝpi dizi. Na adeze a zukǝru, aa acale poso.
A pǝǝri macao, andaaka ne gbwizǝ kaa ne ye ka boome be Ashili, ne ere ka ebeene,
aa komana one susi a ocao o wai. Malo o era Yeso, nane lyǝ a nyimi apeng aa sangsang, aromo acake ne laka ne.

Awere aka ondo gong ana otesa geza o Roma, kaa andaaka neya legwa aa enda Yeso ne laka adeze a zukǝrnu kaa pate epa eka ne laka, na pate one kone boome maleo, aa ne bekaana, “Kanna dongdong Kena ka Ashilia kai!”
Andaye yende acake ka ne tare Yeso aa surǝ aa Galili aane kangkama kai, ne itǝ aa macang a gontaka pate epa eka eya ale.
Aa nyimi one neye, Mariya ka o Magadala, kaa Mariya iini na Yakubu ka Yusupu, aa iini ayana Zabadi kangza.
O taasa o Yeso
Nangka o ulyǝlu waye, na Yusupu, oromo o Arimatiya ka waya ka o cǝ, wai kangza ondo o tare Yeso waze.
Nawa ale aa Bilatus nawa bose na nya wai lepung le Yeso. Na Bilatus ote na nya wai.
Yusupu wa jeke lepung leme, nawa pate le ka betu,
aa wa lyǝǝrǝ lepung leme a nyimi ocau osau oka wa she eke ukpwei wai ka wa kau a lecale. Nawa turki lecale legong leyende nawa pate begmǝ be ocau me, aa wa ale.
Mariya ka o Magadala, kaa Mariya kayende, ne ya zaa ocikǝ a izi ocau me.
Ana le'enda ocau
Ka o sana ara, malo Lengme le Ogoro, na andaamoole magame ma Ashili kaa maParisa gwarnang a begeshe be Bilatus,
nane bekaana, “Ogomo, te rintǝ nangka karomo kaaname ka o rendaza aa ka tata a bengma ka beeze na malo tomore to taaro kayo era ka ebeene.
Azaa nyimi, ote ka eza le'enda ocau me maleo aa dukǝ tomore te taaro, tana atoma akai de kane kpwi ekeze kai aa ne bekaa aromo na ka era malo ogbwǝ ne. Orenda o maare wayo kala obora o buru.”
Na Bilatus bekaa nee na, “Besa na ana otesa geza aa moole, ka e ale kaa e eze le'enda nangka wa gwara.”
Nane ale nane ende ocau ome, aa ne ote bewela becapa be ogomo, aa ne baya ana otesa geza me aa le'enda.
